analysis.title: Canadian Solar Inc. (CSIQ): Shares decline on reports of strategic alternatives review; Sell
key_insights: CSIQ shares fell 25% on Friday after news reports that the company and Recurrent Energy are working with advisors on strategic alternatives, including asset sales, financing and, if necessary, a potential Chapter 11 filing. TAN fell about 7% over the same period.
CSIQ has not commented on the reports. GS stays Sell and cuts the 12-month price target to $5 from $10.
Recurrent Energy was already pursuing strategic actions. In August CSIQ was reported to be working with Guggenheim Securities on options for Recurrent, including asset sales to reduce debt.
Recurrent Energy had about $2.6bn of non-recourse borrowings as of 2Q26 and recently monetized two French BESS projects totaling 200MW/800MWh to BW ESS.
A potential Chapter 11 filing would be a more significant development than the ongoing asset monetizations and financing alternatives.

CSIQ ended 2Q26 with $7.1bn of total debt and $1.9bn of cash. The sequential debt increase mainly reflects additional non-recourse construction financing at Recurrent while the company keeps investing in US manufacturing.

3Q26 results are scheduled for December 3. GS expects focus on the scope of the strategic review, liquidity and debt levels, pace and proceeds of Recurrent asset sales, and any changes to US manufacturing investment plans.
Valuation: the $5 target is a 50/50 blend of a $3 fundamental value (from $7) and an $8 SOTP (from $12). The SOTP is about $1 for CSI Solar and $7 for Recurrent Energy (from $12).
GS estimates show net debt/EBITDA of 8.3x in 2026E and negative FCF yield through 2028E. Market cap is $408.8mn against enterprise value of $7.1bn.

market_movers.rationale: Target cut to $5 from $10 on lower equity value at Recurrent and lower comps. Heavy leverage and a reported strategic review that includes a possible Chapter 11.

sector_views.rationale: Sell on CSIQ given leverage, negative FCF and possible restructuring. TAN fell about 7% on the day.

earnings_insights: 3Q26 results are scheduled for December 3. GS EPS estimate for 9/26E is -$0.87 (GS forecast).
GS FY EPS estimates: 12/25 -$2.06, 12/26E -$2.78, 12/27E -$0.09, 12/28E $1.75 (GS forecasts, basis not specified). The 6/26 quarter shows EPS of -$1.13, labeled as 6/26 with no estimate flag.
GS revenue estimates: $5,395.3mn for 12/26E and $6,483.3mn for 12/27E. EBITDA estimates are $631.1mn for 12/26E and $799.4mn for 12/27E.
risk_factors: Chapter 11 filing risk and possible asset sales at distressed prices.
High leverage with $7.1bn of total debt at 2Q26 against $1.9bn of cash.

Upside risks to the Sell call, as listed by GS: faster module ASP recovery, favorable macro or policy, faster capacity additions, higher energy consumption or prices, faster energy storage adoption, and mix shift.
vol_and_positioning: CSIQ shares fell 25% in one session against about 7% for TAN. Market cap is $408.8mn and 3m ADTV is $23.1mn.
